linework: Medium, consistent hand-drawn thickness; Slightly organic, ink-like variation
humanProportions: Simplified mature illustrated humans; explicitly approved short legs and expressive head/hand proportions are stylization. Extra/missing limbs, broken joints, impossible structure and seriously malformed hands/faces remain hard failures.
backgroundDensity: Low to medium; complex scenes only when narration requires them
propComplexity: 0-3 historically readable functional supports; no decorative clutter requirement
historicalSimplification: period-correct illustrated props, clothing and architecture; uncertainty explicit
negativeSpace: Intentional cream space for clarity and editorial overlays
lightingShading: Extremely minimal, restricted to basic ground plane shadows
textUsage: Only Remotion/editorial text; optional thumbnail text 0-3 words preferred
motionLanguage: Restrained pans, push-ins, detail crops, progressive reveals, labels/arrows/highlights/timelines; no consecutive identical completed frames
futureInheritance: Persist and inherit after owner approval; never rediscover channel style per video
